quote: This page details processes specific to Bill Staples, CEO of GitLab.
fact: The CEO of GitLab is Bill Staples.

quote: **Lead the team that defines and drives GitLab’s strategy & execution.**
fact: The CEO describes his role in 12 words or less as leading the team that defines and drives GitLab's strategy and execution.

quote: I prefer Slack to email. I try to respond to every Slack message I get every day. Keep them concise.
fact: The CEO prefers Slack over email and tries to answer every Slack message the same day.

quote: Use email when it is an external-facing communication, but don’t expect me to respond in < 1 week unless you ask me to look at it sooner over Slack
fact: The CEO may take up to a week to answer email unless asked on Slack to look sooner or it is a critical external matter.

quote: My single biggest ‘hot button’ issue is when someone does not follow through on something they said they would do.
fact: The CEO's biggest hot-button issue is people not following through on what they said they would do.

quote: I like to meet regularly (weekly) to talk about top priorities and our progress on key metrics.
fact: The CEO holds weekly operating meetings on priorities and key metrics because monthly updates proved not frequent enough.

quote: When I have free time, my #1 hobby is cycling with my wife.
fact: The CEO's number one hobby is cycling with his wife; his second is photography.

quote: The CEO shadow program is on hold until further notice.
fact: The CEO Shadow Program is currently on hold until further notice.

quote: Commit to participating at least 6 hours a day between 8am and 6pm Pacific
fact: Shadows more than 3 time zones from Pacific must commit to at least 6 hours a day within the CEO's 8am-6pm Pacific working hours.

quote: If you do not report a score for a meeting, it is assumed that your score is `5`.
fact: Shadows score the CEO's positivity from 1 to 5 after each meeting; a missing score counts as 5, and any score below 5 is sent to the CEO by Slack DM.

quote: participants in the shadow program will be considered Designated Insiders because shadows have access to MNPI.
fact: CEO Shadows are added to the Designated Insider list for the quarter they participate because they see material non-public information.

quote: Understand meeting length. Use the calendar invite as an indication of how long the meeting should last. Remember, we do [speedy meetings](/handbook/communication/#scheduling-meetings).
fact: Shadow timekeeping relies on the calendar invite length, since GitLab uses speedy meetings from the communication guidelines.

quote: When attending **external meetings**, notify the CEO in a private Zoom chat message when the CEO uses the phrase `I think`.
fact: In external meetings, shadows privately tell the CEO via Zoom chat whenever he says the hedge phrase 'I think'.

quote: Draft 2-5 tweets for a 30 minute video, and up to 10 tweets for a 1 hour video.
fact: When drafting a tweet storm, shadows write 2-5 tweets for a 30-minute video and up to 10 for a 1-hour video.

quote: Still, our [Results for Customers value](/handbook/values/#operate-with-a-bias-for-action) mentions to operate with a bias for action.
fact: Shadows may share a quick definitive answer in chat during internal meetings, justified by the bias-for-action principle of the Results for Customers value.
